Complete a series of quests to help Zudash reclaim his estate.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Help Zudash Dejarin regain his estate.
*Complete "[[Estate Planning]]."
*Complete "[[Tendering an Offer]]."
*Complete "[[The Young Lady Vanishes]]."
*Complete "[[Family Ties (Nightfall quest)|Family Ties]]."
*See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.

===Reward===
*4,000 [[Experience]]
*400 [[Gold]]
*160 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s
*[[Kournan Coin]]
*Kournan Coin

==Walkthrough==
Speak to [[Kahan]] in the northern section of [[Pogahn Passage]] in order to begin the series of four sub-quests needed to complete the main objective.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Zudash Dejarin'''
:''"Well Sunspear, I must say my disdain for you is somewhat tempered by the opportunity you have presented to return to me that, which was, shall we say...appropriated...by the current ruler of Kourna. The chaos you brought to this region has averted Varesh's eyes from me for the moment, and now is the time to seize my lost estate. If you help me, I will not compromise your whereabouts. Talk to my man '''Kahan''' in '''Pogahn Passage'''. He has been my contact since my lands were taken from me."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = It is a Sunspear's duty to help all Elonians.
|decline = Blackmail, Zudash? I just fought demons. Blackmail doesn't frighten me.
|ask = It won't be easy, and I really can't give you any other help. They won't even allow me onto my own lands anymore. Try talking to '''Kahan''' in '''Pogahn Passage'''. He and my son are old friends. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zudash Dejarin
:''"I didn't think I would ever see the day! Thank you, Sunspear! You have the eternal support of the Dejarins."''
